posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked:
I just had a hell of a failure.

Vs. Ambuscade in Magmaria. Used all 4 damaging powers, had Enduring Intercession out. (And took 15 damage through it in one turn.) Had every single device, all Magmarians, and one Dodongo under Savage Mana, then used a Haka of Battle (which emptied my deck) and dumped every card I had (32). Dealt Ambuscade 67 damage in one Savage Mana burst, bringing him to -51.

NO UNLOCK!

So, I’m guessing one of three things is true.

First, I either had to have ALL non-hero targets, but since I had all villain targets and one of each environment target, that seems a bit unlikely.

Second, I did something I wasn’t supposed to. Maybe I shouldn’t have used Mere or Taiaha, for instance.

Or, third, Magmaria is not the correct environment.
